heroHeading: From operations and client support to partnerships, resources and impact.
heroParagraph: I am a Partnerships & Resource Mobilization Professional based in Nairobi, Kenya, with 3+ years of experience developing external partnerships, authoring grant applications and managing structured engagement pipelines.
journeyParagraph1: My professional journey has taken me from customer-facing operations into resource mobilization, strategy and partnerships. That progression has given me a practical understanding of people, organizations, data, communication and the discipline required to move a relationship from first contact toward a meaningful outcome.
journeyParagraph2: Today, my work sits at the intersection of partnership development, grant application writing, stakeholder engagement, proposal development and resource mobilization.

experience.company: Africa Asia Middle East Chamber of Commerce (AAMECC)
bullets: I built 9 signed partnerships/MoUs across private sector, NGOs and academia, while managing named partner accounts.
I authored and submitted 10 grant applications and concept notes to international donors and secured a confirmed ESSA Early Childhood Development fund award.
I engaged 8+ foreign embassies and government agencies as part of stakeholder outreach and donor landscape mapping.
I managed a KSh 45M partnership pipeline through structured CRM/tracker follow-ups and supported agreement development with finance and programs teams.

experience.company: Africa Asia Middle East Chamber of Commerce (AAMECC)
bullets: I conducted market scans and performance analysis to inform sector and geographic prioritization for a multi-country resource mobilization strategy.
I drafted concept notes, proposals and internal strategy documents, aligning objectives, interventions, budgets and M&E expectations.
I maintained trackers and consolidated partner reports to strengthen pipeline quality and delivery discipline.

experience.role: Customer Service Representative – Operations & Client Support
bullets: I resolved high-volume customer issues and identified recurring feedback patterns to improve operational service quality and escalation accuracy.
I maintained accurate digital case records, supporting data quality for analytics and reporting.

approachHeading: Strategic thinking. Meaningful relationships. Sustainable impact.
approachParagraph: My approach to partnerships and resource mobilization is grounded in research, collaboration and long-term value creation.
profileTagline: I'm a Partnerships & Resource Mobilization Professional
aboutCopyHeading: Building bridges between purpose and resources.
aboutCopyParagraphs: Organizations often have strong ideas and meaningful missions, but turning those ideas into sustainable programs requires the right partnerships, funding strategy and communication.

My work focuses on helping organizations understand where their opportunities are, how to approach the right partners and how to position their work in a way that creates compelling value for funders and stakeholders.

From donor research and proposal development to partnership management and donor stewardship, I approach resource mobilization as a relationship-building discipline rather than simply a search for funding.
